<cite ref="Berakhot 16a:3">Ib. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>קתני קמיה דר׳ וכ׳</he> reported in the presence (under the presidency) of R. J.

<cite ref="Sotah 2b:28">Sot. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי דקַמָּא</he> what is this before (us)?, i.e. what does this mean? <cite ref="Ketubot 67b">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01437"><he>קָמָא</he> I</cite>.
